component.name: Markdown Viewer
component.summary: View Markdown files in multiple flavors and styles

description.p: Markdown Viewer is a lightweight GTK 4 viewer for Markdown files, made for the Xfce desktop. It is a viewer, not an editor: open a .md file and read it, rendered the way its author intended.

ul.li: Several Markdown flavors: GitHub Flavored (default), CommonMark, original Markdown and PHP Markdown Extra, plus Pandoc Markdown, MultiMarkdown and R Markdown when pandoc is installed
Eight built-in styles (GitHub light, dark and high contrast, Water, Simple, LaTeX and Plain) plus your own CSS styles from a folder, picked up live
Math with KaTeX and Mermaid diagrams, working offline
Syntax-highlighted code blocks and a table of contents sidebar
Automatic reload when the file changes, keeping your place
Find, zoom, print and export to PDF
Links to other Markdown files open in the viewer with back and forward
Documents cannot run scripts or reach the network
